Q5731.reason: During the son's life the brother has no present estate; his interest cuts short the uncle's life estate if the uncle moves and is measured by the uncle's life, so it is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie.

Q5115.reason: Lactate is made from pyruvate by LDH, and activating glycolysis at exercise onset raises pyruvate faster than mitochondria can clear it, increasing lactate production.

Q5932.reason: Intermittent high-intensity exercise elevates catecholamines so hepatic glucose output exceeds muscle uptake and blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes.
